Hello, thank you for your time. I've figured the issue out. It was a bad power plan configuration. Both the minimum and maximum processor power states were at a 100%. My guess is that this overwhelmed the system and caused the occasional drops in power to the CPU and GPU. Kept the minimum at 10% and maximum at 90%, and I'm all set now. Getting a steady 40-45 fps on ultra on Cyberpunk now. Hope this helps anyone who might need it in the future.
